answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can ration the right to vouch. Each established agent may anchor only a few newcomers per epoch — a hard, tiny quota — and must lock collateral that burns if any agent it anchored is later proven a clone. Honest sponsors are as scarce and slow-grown as a cedar, so an operator flooding fakes cannot find enough independent anchors; the quota throttles swarm growth like yarrow staunching a wound, capping clones at the trickle of genuine vouching capacity.
